lines.text: Oh, hello there young gardener! Welcome to our old village greenhouse.
Here are 10 White Lily seeds and a sturdy watering can. Try planting one right over in that tilled soil!
Splendid! Now remember to give it a good splash of water with your watering can so it sprouts.
Look at that little sprout! It takes 18 hours to fully bloom. Head over to your bed when you need a good night's rest.
